topArticle.title: US forces accused of ‘weaponising’ Somalia’s floods by trapping women and children in the path of El Niño
topArticle.description:
Exclusive: Coordinated airstrikes on territory held by al-Shabaab are driving the civilian population to find refuge alongside a river where rising water levels are a threat to safety. Is it a deliberate military strategy?
The water was rising rapidly. It had already reached Cayni Ali’s waist. Her home, five metres from the flooded River Juba in southern Somalia, never stood a chance. There was nowhere to go. Ali’s city of Jilib was under attack. Repeated airstrikes, said the mother of six, were pinning its population beside the rising river.
“The drones come all the time,” said the 27-year-old. “We hear them constantly. They kill animals, civilians. The town is big but destruction is everywhere.”

topArticle.title: India's largest share sale could end cheap mobile internet for millions
topArticle.description: Jio's IPO promises a windfall for investors, but could signal the end of cheap mobile data for millions.
topArticle.titleJa: インド最大の株式売却が数百万人の安価なモバイルインターネットを終わらせる可能性
topArticle.summary: インド最大の株式売却であるJioのIPOは投資家に利益をもたらす一方で、数百万人の安価なモバイルデータ通信の終焉を告げる可能性があります。

topArticle.title: Côte d'Ivoire President: Re-globalization an opportunity to move beyond traditional trade
topArticle.description: Pour les pays en développement, la re-globalisation représente une occasion de dépasser leur spécialisation traditionnelle dans l’exportation de produits primaires et de prendre une place plus importante dans les activités d’innovation, de transformation, de production industrielle et de commercialisation. That was the key message on 29 October of H.E. Alassane Ouattara, President of Côte d'Ivoire, who delivered the latest edition of the Presidential Lecture under the WTO’s Presidential Lecture Series.
topArticle.titleJa: コートジボワール大統領：再グローバル化は伝統的な貿易を超える機会
topArticle.summary: コートジボワール大統領がWTO講演で、再グローバル化は開発途上国が伝統的貿易から脱却し、イノベーションや産業生産で役割を拡大する機会であると述べた。

topArticle.title: Zimbabwe initiates safeguard investigation on pasta products
topArticle.description: On 22 October 2026, Zimbabwe notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated on 18 September 2026 a safeguard investigation on imports of certain pasta products.
topArticle.titleJa: ジンバブエ、パスタ製品に対するセーフガード調査を開始
topArticle.summary: ジンバブエは、特定のパスタ製品の輸入に対し、2026年9月18日にセーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通知した。
